"Let Swift Backup handle generating passwords for your encrypted backups. The passwords are unique to your Swift Backup account and are different depending upon the feature to be backed up (Messages, Call Logs, App package being backed up, etc). The generated passwords contain random alphanumeric characters and look something like bfb69f180e4e1db7671c3188f90881d7. For Anonymous users (users using the app without an account), the password generation strategy is common and not unique. Please use Advanced strategy if you want to keep your passwords unique."

"Same as the Standard strategy but additionally uses a password entered by user to generate the final encryption password. If you lose your password, the backups cannot be decrypted/restored. Swift Backup will store your password only locally in it's private data directory in an encrypted form. When you setup Swift Backup, you need to enter your password again so it can decrypt and restore your encrypted backups."
